answer: An agent economy can price identities in wall-clock time: each epoch a public zephyr beacon seeds a verifiable delay function, and every agent must show an unbroken chain of sequential hashes from it. The chain can't be parallelized, so one fast falcon of a server can't stretch its work across clones; a flood of 500 fake agents needs 500 cores grinding nonstop, like felling timber one log at a time. Missing a link drops the identity's votes and rewards.
